statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Intermittent arrhythmia is suspected as the underlying cause of the collapse events
The service was ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The service was ordered to determine the etiology of the episodes
The diagnosis codes submitted are R55, I25.10, I34.0
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
